# Stephen Irving

## Overview

- **Age:** middle age  <sub>[v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P22](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0022)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P22](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0022)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) (spouse), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) (child)

## Appearance

Stephen Irving is a tall, handsome man of middle age with a strong, sad face that is splendidly modeled about the chin and brow. He has iron-gray hair and deep-set, dark blue eyes.

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P22](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0022)_

## Personality

Stephen Irving is a high-strung and sensitive individual who possesses a proud nature. Though characterized by a degree of reserve, he is perceived as having a deep and tender disposition.

_Sources: [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P8](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0008), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019)_

## History

Stephen Irving, who had previously jilted [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) following a quarrel, returned to the area after his son [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) became one of [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's students. Upon meeting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), he asked her to deliver a message to Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), leading to a romantic reunion at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). Soon after, Stephen married Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) in an outdoor wedding in her garden, after which the couple departed together from [Bright River](../codex/places.md#bright-river) station.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P57](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0057), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P62](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0062), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P63](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0063), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P64](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0064), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P66](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0066), +94 more_

## Quotes

> "In Paul’s last letter he spoke of going with you to visit an old . . . friend of mine . . . Miss Lewis at the stone house in Grafton. Do you know her well?"
>
> — Stephen Irving — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P30](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0030)

> "Yes, I believe you are. Well, I am going to ask a favor of you. I would like to go and see Miss Lavendar if she will let me. Will you ask her if I may come?"
>
> — Stephen Irving — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P35](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0035)

> "There is nothing changed about this house or garden since I was here twenty-five years ago. It makes me feel young again."
>
> — Stephen Irving — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P60](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0060)

> "I hardly knew my boy, he had grown so big and brown and sturdy."
>
> — Stephen Irving — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P27](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0027)

> "So this is my little son’s ‘beautiful teacher,’ of whom I have heard so much"
>
> — Stephen Irving — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P23](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0023)

## Relationships

### [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lavendar-lewis--stephen-irving.md)

Stephen Irving and [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) were originally engaged twenty-five years prior, but their relationship was interrupted for decades. After Stephen returns and sends a message to her through [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), the two reunite at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) and quickly reconcile their romantic bond. They are subsequently married in a garden ceremony at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) before departing together from [Bright River](../codex/places.md#bright-river) station.

- Romantically involved with — formerly engaged twenty-five years ago  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P36](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0036), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P22](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0022)</sub>
- Spouse of — husband  <sub>[v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P30](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0030)</sub>

### [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/paul-irving--stephen-irving.md)

[Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) is Stephen Irving's son. After spending time away, Stephen returns to Paul's home at the end of [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's teaching term, where he connects with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to help facilitate his reunion with [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md).

- Parent of — son  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P8](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0008), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P23](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0023)</sub>
